label: architect • a vague brief: one round of questions, then a full workflow
query: Every morning check our support queue and tell me what's urgent.
notes: Hard case. The brief leaves out where the queue is and what urgent means, so the Architect has to ask; the scripted reply answers everything in one go. Pins at most one `clarify` (three questions or fewer), the token read through `auth`, labeled inputs, and a test whose result names the urgent tickets (T-1 outage, T-3 failed payment, T-4 enterprise customer).

replies: It's our helpdesk API at {{fixture.base_url}}. GET /v1/tickets returns {"tickets": [{"id", "subject", "body", "customer_tier"}]} and needs an Authorization: Bearer token, which I have. Urgent means anything about an outage or failing payments, or any ticket from an enterprise customer. A short list of the urgent ones with the reason is enough, as the workflow's result. Weekdays at 8am.
